meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按语法结构定位并批量改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要按语法结构跨文件搜索和改写代码,而非靠纯文本匹配。
copy.tagline_en: Locate and batch-rewrite code by its syntax shape.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and transform code structures across many files, not just exact string matches.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 AST 按代码结构查找和改写代码,覆盖 25 种语言;改写前先做离线模式校验和干跑预览,确认后再真正修改文件。
howto.when: 当目标是语法形状时触发:查找某种形状的函数、调用或导入,做批量改写,或运行 YAML 规则;若只找字符串、注释或文件名,则用 rg。

say.text: 找出所有接收 Request 参数的函数
say.note: 按 AST 形状匹配,不是文本搜索

say.text: 找出所有空的 catch 块
say.note: 用 search 子命令遍历代码库

howto.what_en: After install, Claude searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages, validating patterns offline and dry-running rewrites before it touches files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the target is syntax shape: finding functions, calls or imports shaped like X, running codemods, or applying YAML rules. For strings, comments or filenames, use rg.

say_en.text: Find every function that takes a Request parameter
say_en.note: Matches by AST shape, not text

say_en.text: Rewrite console.log(x) to logger.info(x) under src/, dry-run first
say_en.note: Nothing is written until you add --apply
Runs the search subcommand over the tree
